ValidationRule.description: Keeps conversation counters, playback speed and call timings within supported ranges.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Unread_Count__c)), OR(Unread_Count__c < 0, Unread_Count__c > 999)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Transcript_Speed__c)), OR(Transcript_Speed__c < 1, Transcript_Speed__c > 99999)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Ring_Seconds__c)), OR(Ring_Seconds__c < 0, Ring_Seconds__c > 999.9)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Notification_After_Seconds__c)), OR(Notification_After_Seconds__c < 0, Notification_After_Seconds__c > 999.9)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Unread count must be 0–999, transcript speed 1–99999 milliseconds, and the call timings 0–999.9 seconds.
